Develop innovative geospatial modelling and decision-support tools, collaborate with industry, and build your research profile while tackling real-world challenges in water, energy, infrastructure and resource optimisation.

Research: Develop high-quality research focused on geospatial modelling and interactive decision-support tools for co-locating AI data centres with critical minerals assets, with a focus on water and energy optimisation and shared infrastructure. You will collaborate on research projects and funding applications, translate research into real-world outcomes, and build a strong emerging research profile using best-practice methodologies.

Supervision and Researcher Development: Contribute to the supervision and development of Honours and Higher Degree by Research students, providing effective feedback, coaching and professional development. Structural Engineer 

At Aurecon, we are optimistic about the future. We are thinkers, solvers, and collaborators who work with our clients to deliver the infrastructure and assets that strengthen communities and create a sustainable future.

What you’ll do 

As a  Structural Engineer in our Mining & Resources team based in Brisbane , you’ll contribute to projects and programs that make a real difference and be part of a team that embraces challenges, welcomes diverse ideas, and engineer solutions with people and outcomes in mind.  

Deliver innovative structural engineering solutions across major bulk materials handling projects, with the opportunity to contribute to complex industrial, resources and emerging market initiatives.
 Contribute to the delivery of projects and design packages, working closely with experienced engineers and multidisciplinary teams.
 Support the development of practical and efficient engineering solutions from concept through to detailed design.
 Engage with clients and project stakeholders as part of project delivery teams to achieve successful outcomes.
 Collaborate with colleagues across Australia and globally, sharing ideas and learning from a diverse network of technical specialists.
 Continue developing your career through meaningful project experience, mentoring, technical learning and professional development opportunities.

What you’ll bring 

Relevant engineering qualifications and demonstrated experience in Structural Engineering.
 Experience in mining, resources or heavy industrial infrastructure would be highly regarded, particularly across bulk materials handling facilities and associated structural assets.
 Working knowledge of engineering tools such as SpaceGass, Strand7, ANSYS, Rhino/Grasshopper, Navisworks or similar software.
 A proactive approach to problem solving and a willingness to take ownership of your work.
 Strong communication skills and an ability to build effective working relationships with clients and team members.
 A desire to learn, grow and contribute to a high-performing engineering team.

How we support your growth 

We believe your career should be a rewarding adventure. You will tackle some of the world’s most complex infrastructure challenges, in an environment that supports your ambitions, where we hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standards. Geotechnical Engineer   
 An exciting mid level role within our Sydney Ground Engineering team. Focus on shaping the future direction of Sydney.  Rewarding career path in a culture of innovation, diversity & eminence.  

Design what’s beneath. Shape what’s next.  
 What if the work you did every day helped shape cities, communities and the future of infrastructure? 
 At Aurecon, that’s exactly what we do. We don’t just solve geotechnical challenges — we rethink them. From complex underground works to major infrastructure, we bring ideas to life in ways that are smarter, more sustainable and future-focused. 
 Now, we’re looking for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Ground & Underground team — someone who’s ready to work collaboratively with the team, push technical boundaries and bring ideas to life. 

What will you do?   
 In this position you will join the Ground and Underground Engineering Practice in our Transport Service Group, where you will play an integral part in a team of highly skilled specialists that ‘Bring Ideas to Life’ for our clients.  With a focus on growing our Ground Engineering capabilities in NSW we are actively recruiting a senior technical person who is passionate about working collaboratively and on building eminence. You’ll play a key role in supporting the delivery of technically complex, high-impact projects while growing your capability to the full potential.  

In this role, you will: 
 Support the delivery of multidisciplinary projects through the provision of geotechnical design at feasibility, concept, detailed design and construction phase services stages. You will have the opportunity to contribute to large transport infrastructure projects, water infrastructure, dams, energy distribution and building projects. 
 Assume responsibility for the management and delivery of small to medium scale geotechnical investigations.   
 Apply intermediate analysis using tools like PLAXIS, GeoStudio, Rocscience and more 
 Provide input to client proposals and tenders 
 Leverage off your passion and experience to support the ongoing development of the Ground Engineering team to achieve growth and diversity objectives. 
 Be encouraged to support the development and maintenance of positive client relationships and ongoing business development through promoting capability and coordinating with other key stakeholders.
